title: Migrate core resources and data sources to terraform-plugin-framework
description: Full migration of betterado_project, betterado_project_features, betterado_project_pipeline_settings, betterado_project_tags, betterado_team, betterado_team_administrators, betterado_team_members resources and betterado_project, betterado_projects, betterado_team, betterado_teams, betterado_client_config data sources from terraform-plugin-sdk/v2 to terraform-plugin-framework.

checkpoints.label: betterado_project_pipeline_settings — roundtrip live pass
checkpoints.notes: Framework implementation with all 6 boolean attributes. Validators ported from SDKv2 (project_id UUID check). Evidence: enforce_job_scope=false, all false → all true → import verify.

checkpoints.label: betterado_project_tags — roundtrip live pass
checkpoints.notes: Framework implementation. Tags set [tag1, tag2] applied and verified via read-back. list(string) attribute replaces SDKv2 TypeSet.

checkpoints.label: betterado_team — CRUD live pass
checkpoints.notes: Framework implementation with name, description, administrators, members. set(string) attributes for members and administrators.

checkpoints.label: betterado_team_members — CRUD live pass
checkpoints.notes: Framework implementation for team membership management. add_mode support preserved.

checkpoints.label: betterado_team_administrators — CRUD live pass
checkpoints.notes: Framework implementation. ACL-based admin management via securityhelper. Permission grant/revoke verified.

checkpoints.label: betterado_team data source — read live pass
checkpoints.notes: Framework data source. Reads team name, description, administrators, members by project_id + name.

checkpoints.label: betterado_teams data source — list live pass
checkpoints.notes: Framework data source. Lists all teams in project, with member/admin expansion.

checkpoints.label: betterado_client_config data source — read live pass
checkpoints.notes: Framework data source. Reads organization_url from ADO connectionData endpoint.

checkpoints.label: betterado_project_features — roundtrip live pass
checkpoints.notes: Framework implementation. Uses artifacts+boards (license-free). testplans excluded to avoid silent license-restriction failures. applyFeatureStates verifies API response state matches requested state.

acEvaluations.notes: betterado_project_features migrated to framework. TestAccProjectFeatures_roundtrip passes against betterado-standing-demo fixture. CaptureLiveEvidence called with label 'project-features'.
betterado_project_pipeline_settings migrated. TestAccProjectPipelineSettings_Enabled passes. Validators: project_id UUID, all 6 bool attributes.
betterado_project_tags migrated. TestAccProjectTags_basic passes. Tags as list(string) with sorted output.
All 12 SDKv2 files deleted. Shared helpers moved to project_helpers.go. go build ./... passes.
pr-description.md updated. Stale deferred-validators and unconfirmed-live-run claims removed. Validators delivered note added.
demo.json created with 9 checkpoints. All cite passing per-type live evidence from betterado-standing-demo fixture.
